$comment: Names that must not appear in anything installable. scripts/deidentify-check.mjs scans every tracked text file under plugins/ and docs/ for these terms (case-insensitive) and fails the build on a hit, unless the file is allowlisted below with a reason. The Open Finance, Islamic banking and risk-reviewer skills are imported from the Claude.ai skills UI as whole-file overwrites (CLAUDE.md, provenance rules); this gate is what makes a careless re-import fail in the PR instead of shipping a client's name to the public marketplace.

allow.reason: historical plan whose task was the ADCB de-identification itself; it names the term to describe removing it
implementation plan whose tasks remove these terms; it names them to specify the removal and the tests
